# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| prototype-validation-record | `assets/prototype-validation-record.md`, filled | `process-derivation`, `bc-build`, `bc-capital-request`, plant representative | Holds the question, the type, the criterion written before the build, the validator (a role), the result (passed, failed or inconclusive), the status label (mock-up, PoC or pilot) and the open items; Nothing in it says "proven" |
| click-dummy-brief | `assets/click-dummy-brief.md`, written before the build | Plant representative (validator) | Filled before anyone builds; Needed for a click-dummy only |
| click-dummy-and-handover-note | The mock-up and its handover note | Plant representative | Mock-up carries invented example values marked as such; Handover document written |
| plant-confirmation-of-value | Written statement in the record | `bc-build` | The plant representative has confirmed or declined the value in writing |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `funnel-features`, `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements`, `mi-data-availability`
- **Next:** passed: process-derivation (step 23a) derives the process, then bc-build (step 24) takes the evidence for the rows, and bc-capital-request if money is needed.: `process-derivation`, `bc-build`, `bc-capital-request`
- **Next:** Failed: back to funnel-use-case, or close the use case.: `funnel-use-case`
- **Next:** Acceptance of a later build stays with deploy-acceptance.: `deploy-acceptance`
- **Stops here when:** the data verdict says the data is not there, a proven library solution answers the need (catalog-standardization), no pass criterion or named plant validator exists, or the open question is a value question
- **Stops here when:** A prototype answers usability and data questions only
